output.scope_note: This is a review of nanoionics in oxide thin films. It reports no numerical ionic conductivity values for solid Li- or Na-ion conductors; the Li-conductor mentions (e.g. Li3xLa0.67-xTiO3 grain boundaries lower by up to 4 orders of magnitude) are relative factors, not conductivities, and the other quantitative results are either oxide-ion or shown only in figures.
